headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Loud!!! Way outside the decibel!! This place is horrible and has caused such a disturbance!! I can't even enjoy my sleep for gods sake!! Is there no rest on the weekdays??? Some people have jobs that require them to get up super early!! The Luna needs to be held accountable

Same guy different SUV!  This time it’s a white Suburban. He likes to park at the corner of 2nd and Nueces St. blocking a 🔥 fire hydrant, 🚶‍♀️crosswalk, and 🛑 stop sign, all while parked in a 🚫 no parking zone!! He’s a quadruple threat! He loves to make this hectic intersection more dangerous for all!

Please do something about him

Luna going crazy!! They always get away with blasting music because they know no one is coming same day to check. So loud!!! Someone please install decibel meters that accurately reflect how loud their music is for neighboring residents. Also please don't try to blame Sheiner again. I can see the DJ from my balcony at Luna.

Bungalow blasting music (again)!!  It is well above 85 dBA.  Bungalow (and Victory Lap) consistently violate Chapter 9-2 and have several previous citations.

Bungalow and Victory Lap should have their OMV permits revoked or at the very least suspended.   

Rainey Ventures / LV Collective should be contacted as they own the business and should be held accountable.  Revoke the OMV permits if they c

One quarter mile of sidewalk Greenbelt COA Parks and Off Leash Doggie Park begins at end of Bridge Apartments Sidewalk Greenbelt begins to  Enclave HOA homes.
Please bring Parks Trail’s Cleanup Crew to this repeat location needing Maintenace.
Includes a fresh Deer hit and dragged on edge of Greenbelt & sidewalk.

If

Vehicular parking in the bike lane near Home Slice Pizza is a constant safety hazard. Cars frequently block the lane, forcing cyclists into active traffic. While enforcement helps, it does not prevent the issue. Please consider installing physical protection—such as flexible bollards or plastic posts—along the outside of this bike lane. These barriers are highly effective in other parts of Austin

Luna way louder than normal. Residents of the city of Austin would greatly appreciate the OMV office taking these complaints seriously and accurately checking decibel levels that are actually affecting us in our apartments, not from street level. Please stop gaslighting us.

Coconut club/Neon grotto/Highlands need to all turn down their music. Not sure which one it is but I can hear it clear as day in my apartment and I’m 37 floors up. Please get this fixed. Tired of them affecting my sleep

There was a water leak at a construction site across the street from my house (1908 Westridge) on 09/02/26 Wednesday evening and I think these signs are from when they came to fix the leak. Thank you for dealing with it quickly! I am requesting that these signs and barriers be taken away if they are done working on the problem because it is a struggle for the workers and residents to find a street

The tops of the irrigation valve boxes in the open field of the park are chronically ill-fitting and broken. This is dangerously because folks running in the field could break their ankle. Can this receive a durable fix?

Husky at apartment 6204 building 6 has been left alone on the balcony on multiple occasions. Today it was outside in about 95°F (35°C) heat for at least 10 minutes, continuously barking and jumping at the door trying to get inside. I’m concerned about the dog’s safety in this heat.

Homeless encampment on upper banks of Shoal Creek. Located just north of Northcross Drive USPS parking lot, 7700 Northcross Drive. Enter from Northcross Drive, north side of the USPS parking lot fence, south side of creek, approximately 2 minute walk along footpath to encampment. On Saturday 8/29/26 at 9am was told 3 people were living there. No photos taken for my own safety but camp is directly

Construction crews unlawfully leaving equipment, unattached trailers and trucks in the right of way.  Leaving trailer trailers with lumber and equipment on the street without trucks attached during the daytime leaving trailers parked on property jutting out into the street, unlawful on parked vehicles blocking right of way including on trash collection day

All No Parking signs on Gonzales Street between Shady Ln and Mansell Ave are knocked over. This is constraining the travel lanes with cars being parked where they shouldn’t. 
There’s needs to be enforcement with the contractor to stand up the No Parking signs and not leave them knocked over.

Traffic light going southbound from Harris branch crossing Parmer is far too short. 
Traffic is backed up to Howard almost every morning.
Going north bound on Harris branch gets priority in the morning and hardly has a line. 
Even parmer lane going west/east has hardly any line and nowhere close to as backed up when compared to going southbound on Harris branch. 

Need a traffic analysis done.

Hello omv permit people, 

Happy Friday! Hope your evening is going well! Luna is doing too much with the volume and the bass once again. 

Thanks!

I filed a request to have these tree limbs cut down before they fall on my house and damage it. You admit they are on Travis County property. They have a duty to cut this tree so that it does not fall on my house and does not tangle up in the powerlines. I was told to call Travis County Services, which Travis County services do I call?

Same dog has been wandering neighborhood away from his unattended home for one week minimum. I STRONGLY suspect he has been abandoned in the heat without any food or water or shelter. He and the other dog from the house appear skinnier and with more scabs and scrapes every time I see them.

Rocks from the planter beds in front of EZPAWN and near the CapMetro bus stop at 1900 E. 7th St., Austin, TX 78702, are spilling onto the pedestrian sidewalk due to lack of boarder / Gaurd. The loose rocks create a potential slip and trip hazard for pedestrians, with a risk of someone stepping on them and falling.

An abandoned vehicle with Nevada license plates has been parked at 11708 Kings View C., Austin for two months without being moved or cared for. This has seriously affected the safety of nearby residents and caused great inconvenience to ambulances and garbage trucks, preventing them from parking in front of several homes and hindering delivery vehicles from delivering goods directly to the neighbo

I submitted a request last week (26-00286279) about a barking dog. The people didn’t do anything about and their dog barked all night. It’s waking up the entire neighborhood. Please start doing something about this.

There has been a stray dog spotted in our neighborhood, Agave, for a week. He seemed to frequent Pinon Vista street, the backyard of a house at 5836 Pinon Vista Dr (has a big hole in their fence) and eventually wound up hanging out on our porch at 5837 Pinon Vista Dr, so I started to put out water and food bowls daily. When neighbors and myself have tried to approach it runs off but it does not se

There are two small dogs that roam the neighborhood 24 hours a day. Small solid brown and a small brown and white one. They come from 1314 Harrison Lane.   We have ask them to keep in yard to no avail. My neighbor put a note on their door no luck there either. They chase us when walking, poop in our yards, bark and scratch at my door all hours of the night.

Pitbull mix and a jack Russel mix I do not have pictures of the other dog, but there is a black-white and gray husky that runs around with them that is also wreaking havoc on the neighborhood the pitbull is somewhat aggressive and very territorial people just walking, exercising or walking their dogs. Do not come this way anymore the dogs are pulling trash out a trash cans and just roaming around

The dog that also lives in the house hasn’t been spotted since Sunday 8/30 and they are always together. I strongly suspect the other black and white dog was either hit by a car, starved, or died of heat stroke. Police did welfare check on abandoned house on Monday 8/31 and there was nobody home.

Neighbors backyard is full of trash. Dog continuously digging through the trash, eating it and ripping it apart in the yard. Trash has been in the backyard for over 8weeks and keeps getting worse. Owner does not answer the dog to have a conversation of our concerns. Dog uses doggie door and is never let out by the male owner. We have now seen rats and nats coming into our yard. The Dog also appear

Trash bags left after creek clean up. The Hungry Hill Foundation came and did creek clean up near an unhoused person’s illegal campsite on Parker Ln near Allegheny Dr. on Tuesday 9/1. Unfortunately the group did not dispose of the bags or coordinate pick up. This is the main group of bags, a couple others have been dragged further away on Parker Ln.

Street light on E 3rd street between Red River and the frontage road doesn’t turn on. I work at Moonshine where we frequently get out late, so having this light operational is an important safety issue for us as there is also a lot of activity from the unhoused population in this area.

Light at Barton springs and Kinney skips multiple cycles to get out of Zilker neighborhood and onto Barton springs. The signals for the cross traffic will turn red for only eastbound or only westbound traffic and still not turn green for traffic on Kinney trying to get on Barton springs. This happens evenings after 7p and mornings before 10a.

On the northbound direction of Cameron Rd, the left turn arrow for the traffic signal at Camino La Costa does not reliably change to allow a left turn. Multiple cycles of the traffic signal are required before a green arrow allows a left turn. Additionally there is no flashing yellow allowing for a cautious left turn with no oncoming traffic. Waiting for 5 minutes or more to turn when there is zer

The No Parking signs that were installed on Gonzales St. have all been knocked down. The construction contractor is not standing them upright. It has been this way for weeks. 
People cannot see the signs and park their cars on Gonzales St between Shady Ln and Mansell Ave. This constrains the travel lanes as a result. 
Can anything be done to enforce the contractor to stand the No Parking signs upr

The traffic pattern on FM 1826 over Highway 290 W. is a nightmare. There are still lanes closed by construction (not sure why), but no accurate signage posted and no lines painted on the road. There are three lanes on one side, but only two on the other with no indication of which lane should go which direction. There are frequent incidents and growing frustration among those of us who use the roa

Watr at the Waterline is blasting music yet again for the second night in a row. It is past 8 pm and is supposed to go on until 2am according to their website. The base is so heavy and it’s shaking apartments. Nearby residents cannot sleep

Loose dog - roaming around Agave neighborhood (Piñon Vista and Florencia / Seville) for over 1 week. Neighborhood has been trying to coax him into backyard and feel him food & water but he is skittish and wandering the streets every day.

Dark brown/black lost dog (I think it’s a bull dog) with a red collar, in bad situation. Panting in the heat and very skinny and looks hungry, seems like either lost or someone dumped him. (Male dog) he has white marks under his belly.

I don’t have a picture, it was about 8:50 at night. I overheard it while walking my dog. I heard a young man beating his dog in his back yard 9008 Spiceland Cir Austin TX 78724.  Do not give the people I’m reporting my email or name.
This is a penis by the children playground and by a park which to visit you have to pay to park. It has been here forever. Does the news need a segment for this to be addressed?
This is Noble 2500 in West Campus. Can you please contact them to clean this up. I live next door and I’m afraid they’re going to cause Roaches. Thank you!

Homeless encampments in Patterson Park.  There are a half dozen homeless camping out and using drugs in Patterson Park, there is trash everywhere.  This is very close to the children’s playground and basketball courts.
